# Phone-first V1 journey: screen and state inventory

<!-- Generated by design/tools/v1-phone-docs.mjs from design/v1-phone/contract/journey.json (v1-phone-0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

**A proposal, not owner-approved.** Issue [#76](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/issues/76). Design base `87715a46dbd6a107e417bb6024d81c3fcb679049` on `codex/v1-start-sequence` ([PR #75](https://github.com/Amirkianfar66/GameN/pull/75), unmerged). Ruleset `in-person-v1-2026-10-06`, engine `full-game-1.0.1`, protocol 2, setup lifecycle `staged-start-1`, Original Powers off. Tokens 0.4.0, assets `design-0.2.0`, crew `crew-0.1.0`.

109 states on 11 screens: **101** the release already produces (the design changes how they look), **7** need Frontend work only, **1** need something the release does not have. Every state is drawn in the prototype from a labeled synthetic fixture with the same id; open one at `/v1-phone/?state=<id>` on the design review server. The journey map, the reasoning and the handoff are in [v1-phone-journey.md](v1-phone-journey.md) and [v1-phone-handoff.md](v1-phone-handoff.md).

## What the runtime column means

| Level | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `existing` | The pinned release already produces this state from this data. The design changes how it looks and is laid out, not what it says or when. |
| `partial` | The release has the data and the operation, but not this presentation or one part of it. Frontend work only; no contract or backend change. |
| `proposed` | Needs something the release does not have: a contract field, a backend answer, a new capability or an owner decision. Labeled PROPOSAL wherever it is drawn. |

## Authorized data sources

| Name | What it is, and who may read it |
| --- | --- |
| `local` | This device's own input and command flow: not authoritative, never stored beyond what the release already keeps. |
| `session` | matches/{id}/control/session, read by the host only (readHostSession): matchId, roomCode, playerCount, status. |
| `lobby` | matches/{id}/lobby/public (FullLobbyView): status, seats[seatId, initialRoom]. Readable by admitted members; the host is admitted as a display member. |
| `admissions` | matches/{id}/admissions/{admissionId}: uid, status pending\|approved, initialRoom, seatId, requestedAt. The host lists all; a requester reads its own. |
| `practice` | matches/{id}/practice/public: botSeatIds only. |
| `identities` | matches/{id}/identities/public (crew-0.1.0): seats[seatId, displayName, characterId], locked. Public. |
| `setup` | matches/{id}/setup/public (staged-start-1): stage lobby\|choosing\|awaiting-ready\|running\|aborted, choosingEndsAt, readingEndsAt, seats[seatId, confirmed, ready], dealId. Neutral; no role. |
| `setupPreview` | matches/{id}/setupPlayerViews/{uid} (FullSetupPlayerView): dealId, bindingRevision, self.role. The own role only, readable only by the current binding during awaiting-ready. |
| `playerView` | matches/{id}/playerViews/{uid} (FullPlayerView, protocol 2): the public facts plus self, knowledge, legalTargets, ownPendingCommandIds, ownBallot, hasVoted, hackPartnerSeatId. |
| `publicView` | matches/{id}/views/public (FullPublicView, protocol 2): round, phase, activeSeatId, seats, ballot, lastTally, result, endReveal. |
| `acknowledgments` | The seat's own acknowledgments document (OwnAcknowledgments): supplierResults, receivedSupply, historyAvailable. |
| `serverTime` | v1ServerTime samples calibrating a monotonic local estimate. A countdown is an estimate and never ends a window. |
| `receipt` | The answer to this device's own operation or command: accepted/registered, rejected (PHASE_CLOSED, NOT_ALLOWED), failure codes, or no answer. |

## 2. Player joining and waiting

Route: `?as=player`. One of the five priority screens.

Not separate states, on purpose:

- Unknown room, a room that has started or ended, and a device already in the room are one answer from the server (FORBIDDEN from requestAdmission). The phone says so in one sentence and does not pretend to know which.
- A full lobby is not refused: the request is accepted and waits. The host sees that there is no free seat (host.no-free-seat).

| State | Surface · audience | Drawn from | In the release | Gap | Picture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `join.code` ★<br>Room code and starting room | player · public | `local` | **existing**. main.js player(): #connected-room-code-input, #connected-initial-room, #connected-join → requestAdmission | Room tiles replace the select (same request). | [png](../../design/v1-phone/review/states/join.code.png) |

| `join.sending`<br>Asking to join | player · public | `local` | **existing**. operate('join'…) 'Asking to join…' | — | [png](../../design/v1-phone/review/states/join.sending.png) |
| `join.no-answer`<br>No answer: send the same request | player · public | `receipt` | **existing**. keeping('join'…): Send the same request again / Give this request up | — | [png](../../design/v1-phone/review/states/join.no-answer.png) |
| `join.refused` ★<br>The room cannot take this request | player · public | `receipt` | **existing**. operate(): 'refused by the server (FORBIDDEN)' | Words proposed. A request left pending when the host starts setup without it is never closed: PROPOSAL to Integration (see handoff). | [png](../../design/v1-phone/review/states/join.waiting-host.png) |

## Components

Reuse names the existing contract component (design/contract/component-states.json) or runtime hook the state is drawn on. Hooks marked PROPOSED are new.

| Component | Reuse | Hook | Surfaces | Audience | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `masthead` | shell-header | `PROPOSED header.j-mast > .j-mast__word, .j-mast__surface, .j-mast__link` | host, player, display | public | Compact top bar: wordmark, surface word (HOST, PLAYER, DISPLAY) and the connection chip. 44 CSS px tall at most; never holds an action that matters. |
| `screen-caption` | new | `PROPOSED h1.j-cap with .j-cap__icon` | host, player, display | public | The screen's title as a slanted comic caption in the approved caption yellow. Live text; wraps rather than truncates. |
| `banner-data-source` | banner-data-source | `.ms-banner--data-source` | host, player, display | public | Fixture or emulator label. Never shown for a live match. |
| `banner-connection` | banner-connection | `.ms-banner--connection[data-variant]` | host, player, display | public | Reconnecting / stale / unreadable update. Stays in view above the content. |
| `action-dock` | new | `PROPOSED .j-dock (sticky, bottom, safe-area padded)` | host, player | public | The one primary action of the screen, in the thumb zone. At least 4rem tall (token component.dockMin), 44 CSS px controls, env(safe-area-inset-bottom). Inline at the end of the content on desktop and when the keyboard is up. |
| `button` | button | `.ms-button, .ms-button--primary; PROPOSED .ms-button--danger, .ms-button--quiet` | host, player, display | public | Ink-bordered comic buttons. Primary is amber (press this). Danger is paper with an ink hatch and the word; never red, which is a team color. |
| `status-chip` | marker-health | `PROPOSED .j-chip[data-kind] (setup: choosing, confirmed, reading, ready, bot, waiting)` | host, player, display | public | A word in a shape. Confirmed and Ready are a solid ink chip with a check glyph; waiting states are dashed. Color is never the only difference. |
| `window-timer` | phase-timer | `PROPOSED .j-timer[data-state] + .j-bar (role=timer, aria-live off)` | host, player, display | public | A server-timed window as seconds in an ink box and a bar that empties. At zero it only changes the words to waiting for the server. Unsynced shows –:–– and says so. |
| `notice` | new | `PROPOSED p.j-notice[data-kind=info\|problem\|uncertain] (role=status)` | host, player, display | public | One line about what just happened to this device's request. Problem and uncertain notices carry a glyph and a heavier border, not only a color. |
| `sheet` | new | `PROPOSED dialog.j-sheet (bottom sheet, modal, focus kept inside)` | host, player | public | A bottom sheet for a less frequent public task: share, recovery codes, the display, ending the match. Never holds anything private; the private card has its own sheet. |
| `disclosure-row` | new | `PROPOSED details.j-more > summary` | host | public | A collapsed row for a less frequent host tool, with its current state in the summary ("Practice bots · 3 bots"). |
| `route-door` | new | `PROPOSED a.j-door[href="?as=host\|player\|display"]` | any | public | Three large entry tiles that map to the existing routes. The device identifier moves behind Details: only a display needs it. |
| `seat-count-picker` | new | `PROPOSED fieldset.j-count > input[type=radio] x3` | host | public | 7, 8 or 9 seats as three radio tiles. Replaces the select of the release; same request. |
| `room-code` | new | `PROPOSED .j-code (aria-label spells the code) + Copy, Share` | host, player | public | The 12-character room code in three groups of four, monospaced, at least 1.75rem. Copy uses the clipboard; Share and a QR join link are PROPOSALS. |
| `seat-slots` | new | `PROPOSED ol.j-slots > li.j-slot[data-seat][data-state]` | host, player, display | public | One slot per seat in seat order: the numbered token or the chosen character, the name once set, the starting room, Bot, and the setup chip. Never anything private. |
| `admission-request` | new | `PROPOSED li.j-request[data-admission][data-status]` | host | public | A request to join: the device tag the requester also sees, the room they start in, the free seat to give them, Seat, and the kept-request controls. |
| `bot-stepper` | new | `PROPOSED .j-stepper inside the runtime's section.connected-practice` | host | public | Fewer / more bots with the count between them and one Add, Update or Remove control. Bots fill only free seats; human seats are never removed. |
| `setup-progress` | runtime: section.connected-setup-progress (#setup-progress-status, #setup-countdown, #setup-progress-seats) | `section.connected-setup-progress` | host, player, display | public | Neutral progress of the two setup windows: how many have confirmed a character or pressed Ready, and who is still choosing or reading. No role, faction or device. |
| `host-status` | new | `PROPOSED section.j-hoststatus` | host | public | While a match runs: round, phase, whose turn and the countdown from the public view, and the host's tools. The host identity is already admitted as a display member, so it may read the public view. |
| `recovery-code` | runtime: #connected-recovery-codes | `PROPOSED .j-recovery` | host | host | A one-time seat recovery code in groups for reading aloud, with its seat, its expiry and Take it off this screen. Shown from memory only; never in an address or storage. |
| `display-admit` | runtime: #connected-display-uid | `PROPOSED .j-admit` | host | public | The identifier the shared display shows, typed or pasted, and Admit the display. |
| `confirm-sheet` | runtime: #connected-end, #connected-end-cancel, #connected-end-confirm | `PROPOSED dialog.j-sheet[data-kind=confirm]` | host | public | Two presses to end a match. Focus lands on the way back; the control that ends the match is not where the first one was. |
| `code-field` | runtime: #connected-room-code-input | `PROPOSED .j-field--code` | player | public | The room code entry: 12 characters, uppercase as typed, grouped visually, inputmode text, autocomplete off. |
| `room-choice` | runtime: #connected-initial-room | `PROPOSED fieldset.j-rooms > label.j-roomtile[data-room]` | player | public | Room A or Room B, as two radio tiles with each room's art and caption. The choice is made before roles and has no role restriction (V1-01). |
| `waiting-card` | runtime: #connected-waiting | `PROPOSED section.j-wait[data-state]` | player | public | Where this device stands before setup: request sent, seated, refused, ended. Carries the device tag the host sees, so the two can be matched by eye. |
| `recover-form` | runtime: #connected-recover-match, #connected-recover-code | `PROPOSED .j-recover` | player | public | Take over a seat with the match identifier and the host's one-time code. The code leaves the field when the request is made. |
| `character-choice` | character-choice (contract 0.2.0) and runtime button.crew-option[data-character] | `button.crew-option[data-character][aria-pressed][aria-disabled]` | player | public | Nine character tiles. Available, selected (lifted, check, yellow), taken (greyed, holder's number and name, not offered), confirmed (stamp). |
| `name-field` | runtime: #crew-name | `PROPOSED .j-field--name with .j-count` | player | public | Public name, 1 to 12 characters as the contract counts them (code points). The counter counts the same way. |
| `crew-preview` | new | `PROPOSED .j-crewpreview` | player | public | The confirmed piece as everyone will see it: standee, seat number and name. Public. |
| `role-card-back` | new | `PROPOSED .j-rolecard[data-face=back]` | player | public | The concealed role card. Identical for every role, every seat and every state: no name, color, device or role-specific hook. |
| `role-card` | role-card (contract 0.2.0) and runtime .ms-role-card--full | `.ms-role-card--full[data-device][data-character][data-team] inside the open private panel only` | player | private | Face up: the player's own character with the role's device added, the role name no larger than a heading, the team word beside a swatch. |
| `role-guide` | runtime: p.setup-role-guide (ROLE_GUIDE) | `p.setup-role-guide` | player | private | The release's concise rule reminder for the role, unchanged words. No match-specific knowledge, target or teammate. |
| `ready-control` | runtime: #setup-role-ready, #setup-ready-waiting | `#setup-role-ready` | player | public | Ready, enabled once the card has been turned up for this deal. Pressing it early is allowed and shortens nothing. |
